descriptionText:
John Guilfoil Public Relations is hiring a Wordpress Specialist for its Website Division. The role designs, builds, updates, and supports client websites, including transferring data and launching new sites, while responding to client support requests.
Responsibilities
Website design (blocks and custom/css), moderate Wordpress development, day-to-day updates/edits as requested by clients, transferring of data to new sites and new website builds
Meeting with the clients to understand their wants and needs
Exploring templates and layouts
Building out a Wordpress website
Ultimately launching a new and advanced website
Respond to client support requests in a timely manner
Develop and Design Wordpress websites with moderate functionality
News blogs, public safety/police/fire websites, school and government websites
Membership sites, news/event portals, agency websites, event ticketing, LMS
Work with the team on existing client websites and new website creation
Partner with Account Teams to troubleshoot client website errors and problems as they arise
Other duties and special projects as assigned
Skills
Understanding of the Wordpress platform & navigating the backend dashboard with Gutenberg Blocks and other editors
Design eye and development skill from kickoff to launch
Knowledge of Wordpress Plugins such as Gravity Forms, Events Calendar Pro, Paid Memberships Pro, Advanced Forms, ACF, etc
Exhibit the ability to effectively communicate and demonstrate organizational skills
Familiarity with the Adobe Creative Suite, specifically Photoshop
Familiarity with Canva
Familiarity with Social Media Platforms such as; Facebook, Instagram, X, and LinkedIn
Familiarity with Cloudflare
HTML, CSS, Javascript and PHP experience
Ability to work positively and collaboratively with co-workers and clients
Ability to work in a team environment and maximize input effectively across all levels
Ability to work independently with managers oversight
Self-motivated
Effective time management skills to manage multiple tasks/projects simultaneously
Committed to the company's vision, mission and strategic goals
Intermediate knowledge of WordPress themes and plugins, graphic design software
Custom Fields experience a plus
Company Overview
John Guilfoil Public Relations provides strategy, content, press releases, crisis management, website design, and development services. It was founded in 2013, and is headquartered in Groveland, Massachusetts, USA, with a workforce of 11-50 employees. Its website is https://jgpr.net.
